+def write_worktree_patch(workspace: Path, paths: list[str], target: Path) -> None:
+    """Persist the exact agent-mutated diff, including untracked files, without touching the real index."""
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fd, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hermclaw-artifact-index-")
+    os.close(fd)
+    index_path = Path(index_name)
+    try:
+        index_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        env = {**os.environ, "GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
+        read_tree = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "read-tree", "HEAD"], cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30, env=env
+        )
+        if read_tree.returncode != 0:
+            target.write_text("# Patch unavailable: " + redact(read_tree.stdout + read_tree.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+            return
+        selected = sorted({str(path).strip().replace("\\", "/") for path in paths if str(path).strip()})
+        if selected:
+            add = subprocess.run(
+                ["git", "add", "-A", "--", *selected], cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60, env=env
+            )
+            if add.returncode != 0:
+                target.write_text("# Patch unavailable: " + redact(add.stdout + add.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+                return
+        diff = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff", "--"],
+            cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60, env=env,
+        )
+        target.write_text(diff.stdout if diff.returncode == 0 else "# Patch unavailable: " + redact(diff.stdout + diff.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+    finally:
+        index_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def render_protocol(events_path: Path, protocol_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Render the redacted JSONL event stream into the human-readable protocol used in the UI/console."""
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    if events_path.exists():
+        for raw in events_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
+            try:
+                event = json.loads(raw)
+                kind = str(event.get("kind", "event")).upper()
+                message = redact(str(event.get("message", "")))
+                lines.append(f"[{kind}] {message}")
+            except Exception:
+                lines.append("[EVENT] " + redact(raw))
+    protocol_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    protocol_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else ""), encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def publish_run_artifacts(
+    repo: str,
+    base_branch: str,
+    job_id: str,
+    code_branch: str,
+    task: str,
+    job_dir: Path,
+    workspace: Path,
+    files_changed: list[str],
+    push: bool,
+    logger: EventLogger,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Publish diagnostics on a separate ``agent-runs/<job>`` branch.
+
+    The diagnostics branch is intentionally separate from the code branch so run
+    logs never pollute a later merge.  It is published on both success and
+    failure when ``--push`` is enabled.
+    """
+    protocol_path = job_dir / "protocol.log"
+    render_protocol(job_dir / "events.jsonl", protocol_path)
+    write_worktree_patch(workspace, files_changed, job_dir / "working-tree.patch")
+    metadata = {
+        "version": VERSION,
+        "job_id": job_id,
+        "code_branch": code_branch,
+        "base_branch": base_branch,
+        "published_at": utc_now(),
+        "task": redact(task),
+        "files_changed": sorted(files_changed),
+    }
+    (job_dir / "metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    if not push:
+        return {"published": False, "branch": None, "reason": "--push nicht gesetzt"}
+
+    artifact_branch = f"agent-runs/{slugify(job_id, 80)}"
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hermclaw-run-artifacts-") as td:
+        clone = Path(td) / "repo"
+        proc = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "clone", "--no-tags", repo, str(clone)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=180
+        )
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            raise AgentError("Diagnose-Repository konnte nicht geklont werden:\n" + truncate(proc.stdout + proc.stderr, 3000))
